IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Friday 20 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming easterly 10 to 15 knots in the early afternoon then turning north to northeasterly below 10 knots in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm during this afternoon and early evening.

Saturday 21 November

Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 90% chance of showers.

Monday 23 November
Winds: West to northwesterly 10 to 15 knots decreasing to about 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.

IDT12420.synoptic: A low pressure system over the Bight will move to the southwest of Tasmania during Friday, with an associated trough to cross the state early on Saturday morning. A narrow ridge of high pressure will cross Tasmania overnight Saturday, ahead of a strong cold front to cross late Sunday and early Monday. A trough is expected to cross Tasmania during Monday and bring a cold southwesterly change.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Friday 20 November
Winds: East to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots tending north to northeasterly during the day.
Seas: Around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres offshore.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 metres.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm inshore during this afternoon and early evening.

Saturday 21 November
Winds: Northerly 15 to 20 knots shifting west to southwesterly during the morning and early afternoon. Winds reaching up to 30 knots offshore in the afternoon.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing below 1 metre during the morning, then increasing to 1.5 to 2.5 metres around midday.
Swell: Southwesterly 1.5 to 2 metres, decreasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the morning.
Swell: Northeasterly around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the morning.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 50% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm inshore in the early afternoon.

Sunday 22 November
Winds: Northwest to southwesterly 15 to 20 knots tending north to northeasterly 20 to 30 knots during the morning then tending north to northwesterly 15 to 25 knots during the evening.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the morning.
Swell: Southwesterly 1 to 1.5 metres inshore, increasing to 1 to 2 metres offshore.
Swell: Northeasterly 1 to 2 metres, decreasing to around 1 metre during the morning.
Weather: Cloudy. 90% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm in the evening.
